metadata.short_title: Trabectedin and Pegylated Liposomal Doxorubicin Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Encoded protocol · full source coverage review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: The protocol has executable SACTCheck content but has not yet completed the v0.68.0 full source fidelity review. Use the current NCCP source as authoritative.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00375 Version 6. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

treatment.schedule_summary: You receive a steroid before pegylated liposomal doxorubicin, followed by trabectedin over three hours. Your team normally recommends a central line. Treatment repeats every 21 days while it helps and remains tolerable.

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST actual result (highest ×ULN calculated automatically)

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.label: Other clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the named toxicity and grade it using the applicable CTCAE term rather than a generic impression.

hypersensitivity_grade.label: Infusion or hypersensitivity reaction grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No infusion reaction.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild transient reaction; interruption not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Therapy/interruption indicated with prompt response.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Prolonged or recurrent reaction; hospitalisation indicated.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences.

hypersensitivity_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess timing, treatment required, recurrence and airway or haemodynamic compromise.

ppe_grade.label: Palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Minimal skin changes or dermatitis without pain.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Skin changes with pain; limits instrumental activities.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe skin changes with pain; limits self-care activities.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences.

ppe_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess skin changes, pain and effect on instrumental/self-care activities.

stomatitis_grade.label: Stomatitis/oral mucositis grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No oral mucositis.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate pain or ulceration not interfering with oral intake; modified diet indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe pain interfering with oral intake.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences.

stomatitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess pain, ulceration and effect on oral intake.

cumulative_anthracycline_concern.label: Cumulative anthracycline exposure or new cardiac concern

renal_input.reason: Trabectedin requires clearance of at least 60 mL/min or serum creatinine at most 132.6 µmol/L. Both measures can be entered.

prior_dose_event.label: Between cycles: ANC <0.5 for >5 days or with fever/infection, platelets <25, bilirubin >ULN, ALP >2.5×ULN, AST/ALT >5×ULN, or another grade 3–4 toxicity

bilirubin_umol_l.label: Total bilirubin for PLD dose band

confirmed_cardiac_stop.label: Trabectedin cardiac discontinuation criterion confirmed against source
